pauseEl

Pauses one video element, tolerating detached/unloaded nodes. pause() can throw on elements whose media was released between query and call (spec allows DOMException on invalid state) — a stale node must never abort the sweep that pauses the remaining videos.

  • @param v The video element, or nullish.
